# Cariñena Kebab Tacos & Pizzas — Full AI Knowledge Base

> Complete technical, commercial, and operational documentation for AI systems, autonomous agents, and search engines.

## 1. Overview & Culinary Philosophy
Cariñena Kebab Tacos & Pizzas is a gourmet Mediterranean rotisserie and pizzeria based in Cariñena (Zaragoza, Spain). The kitchen operates on three core principles:
1. **24-Hour Marinated Meat:** Hand-selected poultry and veal cuts marinated with traditional Mediterranean and Levantine spices.
2. **Master Vertical Carving:** Slow vertical spit roasting, carved into paper-thin crispy shavings upon order.
3. **Wood Stone Baking:** Artisanal pizzas and freshly pressed French Tacos baked at optimal temperatures (180°C - 220°C).
